summary: Frontend-only verification of the Master Data sidebar flyout bug fix in e-SAKIP (Laravel). Logged in as superadmin, tested desktop hover behavior across the icon→flyout gap, click navigation to all 6 sub items, close delay, click toggle, z-index/overlay (elementFromPoint), mobile inline expand, and login page render. All scenarios pass.
critical_code_review_comments: app.blade.php line 110: flyout uses lg:pl-4 as a hover bridge – good. Consider also removing lg:-top-2 or verifying it doesn't push flyout above the icon on short viewports (currently fine at 1920x800).
The 250ms close timeout stored in Alpine's `t` is per-item scope – OK; just note that rapid re-entries properly clear it (verified).
/app/memory/test_credentials.md is essentially empty; main agent should populate with the demo credentials used (superadmin@esakip.go.id / password123, etc.) for future testing agents.
test_credentials: superadmin@esakip.go.id / password123 (used); other demo accounts available via login-demo-toggle on login page
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page uses data-testid=login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button (type=submit, text 'Masuk'). The input name is `login`, NOT `email`. Sidebar master-data nav uses data-testid=nav-master, flyout=nav-master-flyout, items=nav-master-{slug}: periode, opd, unit-kerja, satuan, pengguna, pustaka-indikator. Flyout close delay is 250ms. Mobile menu via data-testid=mobile-menu-button.

desktop_1920x800.close_delay_~250ms: visible at 100ms after leave, hidden at 500ms
desktop_1920x800.flyout_not_covered_by_cards: elementFromPoint on OPD item returned the <a data-testid=nav-master-opd> itself
